issue.body:
# Clarify Qin pickling-liquor culture provenance, recipe and oxidation/phase interpretation

The complete original Qin et al. paper, DOI [10.1080/19443994.2014.981221](https://doi.org/10.1080/19443994.2014.981221), is acquired from the official journal archive and all eight figures/Table 1 inspected. The new spent-steel-pickling-liquors record preserves the following source limitations; this is a source clarification, not a corrective defect in the qualified owner.

- Section 2.1 identifies an isolate from a Tianjin ferric-chloride factory outlet, but its cited [KF378735.1](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nuccore/KF378735.1) is A. ferrooxidans XJF-8 with coal-mine-drainage / China: Shanxi source qualifiers. Establish the correct experimental isolate/accession and source provenance.
- Sections 2.1-2.2 give 0.5 g/L FeSO4·7H2O in 9K and raw liquor Fe(II) 250 mg/L, while section 3.1 gives 7.13/5.35/3.57 g/L for the 20/40/60% mixtures. Obtain corrected units, dilution steps and reagent/iron/acid balances rather than silently repairing them.
- Define Figure 1 CK preparation, sterility/inoculation, actual working volume/inoculum and replicate/error-bar basis. Reconcile the 40% arm's after-84-h versus at-80-h text with its graph, and the Methods mixing grid with the reported 70/80% nulls.
- Table 1 and Figures 3-4 label chloride concentrations but prose sometimes labels NaCl/KCl amounts; resolve the ion/salt basis and delayed-versus-no-inhibition wording. The single-factor design must not be turned into a demonstrated joint pH/Fe/chloride operating point.
- Resolve section 3.3.1 potassium-jarosite wording versus its ammonium formula, and provide adequate phase/element balances before any pure-product or waste-iron recovery claim. Explain the FTIR adaptation interpretation and retain its causal limits.

Acceptance: an accessible original correction, data supplement or adequately documented author clarification must support any changed claim; reassess affected record evidence and save a new native review before broadening the accepted scope. Missing product yields or controls remain unknown. No claim of isolated iron recovery, detoxification or industrial deployment is currently made.

Deduplication: the 232-entry all-state round95 inventory and hidden/ignored, symlink-followed maintained/referenced-source searches were checked. Existing #178 addresses a different Kordloo2024 electroplating-sludge reagent/experiment issue; #93 is a general secondary-resource backlog. No exact Qin DOI/accession source issue was found in these bounded searches. Coordinator should repeat live duplicate checking before posting.
issue.title: Clarify Qin pickling-liquor culture provenance and experimental inconsistencies
